# Site section general standards

## Javascript/Typescript standards

- Prefer dom api and vanilla js over external dependencies, and before adding any dependency, ask the user if it is necessary

## Sass standards

- Use Scss syntax for stylesheets
- Use BEM naming convention for class names

## Pug standards

- Use Pug for HTML templating
- Prefer semantic HTML elements and follow best practices for accessibility
